old_text:
Watch: At the scene of protests on the streets of Lille
Students, their parents and unions are protesting across France, demanding better investment in high schools.
It marks the latest day of demonstrations over the past week, some of which have turned violent as protesters and authorities clashed.
The BBC's Nick Beake reports from Lille in the north of France.
